column1: Stir the melted butter, mustard, Worcestershire, and salt together in a shallow bowl. Combine the bread crumbs and Parmesan in a second shallow bowl.
Dip each chicken breast in the butter mixture, then press into the crumb mixture so it sticks.
Arrange in an ungreased 15x10x1-inch pan and drizzle with any leftover butter mixture.
Bake uncovered 25–30 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F.
